paragraphs.dominant_move: says education is an essential issue for any country in any time
says the higher education determines the height of the national education development
says therefore the health and sustainability of the national higher education system is required to be evaluated comprehensively
says firstly 20 sets of data for 22 countries are collected and integrated to 12 indices
says we divide these 12 indices into three dimensions which are school development, student treatment and social influence
says we combine the group decision making method with the entropy weight method to calculate the weight
says then we build the three-dimensional vector assessment model
says the modulus of the vector represents the comprehensive health level while the deviation angle indicates the balanced sustainable condition
says the UK ranks first in sustainability with the smallest deviation angle of 1.15 degrees
says the US ranks first in health level with the longest modulus of 1.278
says India with a modulus of 0.735 and an angle of 23.13 degrees has a lot of room for development
says therefore we choose India for further discussion
says secondly we establish the curved-surface target model to configure the achievable vision for India
says based on the Indian current vector the modulus lengthens and the angle reduces within a certain range
says during the short and medium terms policies will help India achieve balanced development reducing the angle to 11.5 degrees
says in the long term the comprehensive health level of India will be enhanced increasing the modulus to 1.22
says thirdly we introduce the N-Verhulst model to predict the development without policy intervention in 20 years
says without policies the angle will be 29.96 degrees and the modulus will be 0.640
says after intervention the final modulus will change to 0.978 and the angle will be 4.86 degrees which proves the validity
says in the end we analyze the influence of changing the higher education system realizing that changes are difficult
says education is the chief defence of nations
says it is believed that education is the soul of a country
says particularly the higher education of a country plays a critical role not only in educating future generations but also in every field
says and its development is constrained by many factors and weighed against the development of many other industries
says the higher education is a greatly huge system in a country
says however the health of the higher education system is surely not related merely to any isolated factors but to comprehensive aspects
says the issue of how to make the system healthy as well as sustainable is also complicated with the limitations from different areas
says at present all around the world the systems have different developments and emphases which needs a scientific and accurate assessment system
says meanwhile various targets and policies are also needed to propose for the better enhancement
says knowing the magnitude of the healthy and sustainable higher education system we should concentrate on the problems needed
says the total goal is to assess the health and sustainability and provide scientific suggestions and policies
says the system should not only be as developed as possible when matching to the strength of the country but also develop in balance
says above all we are requested to build an evaluation model to assess the health condition
says the assessment is required to fit almost all the countries in the world and has high accuracy with guidance significance
says several countries should be selected to be substituted into the assessment and receive scientific analysis
says during which we should choose one certain country that has development space for detailed consideration
says for the selected country taking many non-educational factors into account we are required to propose an achievable and rational target
says contrast should be conducted between the current situation and the vision
says after that targeted policies with an action timeline will be provided according to our model
says we also need to assess the effectiveness of the policies by scientific model
says through which we will realize that diverse impacts will appear on the road to be healthy and sustainable
says from students to teachers from schools to society and even to the country influence spreads widely with benefit or cost
says the discussion will deliver the viewpoint that change is of great difficulty

global_organization_chain: Define health as level and sustainability as balance
Score both with one vector, modulus and angle
Pick the country that is weak on both
Pull the ideal back to a cap the country could reach
Order the policy by the figure: angle first, level second
Show the no-policy path getting worse, then the resistance the policy itself creates

main_argument_chains.claim: India can be moved from a short, badly angled education vector to a cap of radius 1.22 inside an 11.5 degree cone, but the change will meet immediate resistance.
support_steps: Split health into modulus and balance into angle to (1,1,1)
Blend expert weights with entropy weights and score eight countries
Show the UK winning on angle and the US on modulus, so the two measures differ
Select India, weak on both, with social influence at 0.16
Use HDI, fragility, and inequality to set a cap rather than the ideal point
Forecast the no-policy path, with student treatment falling 3.2 percent a year
Show the policy reversing that fall and raising social influence growth
List the cost to students, teachers, schools, communities, and the country
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Work on coverage, research influence, and talent competitiveness first, because those close the angle, and only later build the funds system and recruit foreign students.
